note: 物語の声。auditions：人物ごとに同じセリフを声の候補で読む（/preview/story-assets の「声」）。chosen：決まった声（"Gemini の声の名前" か { voice, pitch（半音）, echo（0〜1）, growl（0〜1）, brief } か { fish: 録音ファイル } ）→ その人の全セリフを作る。声を変えたら redo に名前を入れて作り直し。 batch：本番セリフを1回に何行作るか（0＝作らない。クライアントの OK まで 0）。

auditions.name: KIMORIN
auditions.brief: KIMORIN: a young, cheeky, over-confident boy inventor who fails a lot but is never scared; loud, bright, quick, a little show-off, speaks with a playful Hakata accent (ends lines with ケン / やけん)

auditions.name: OBOLON
auditions.brief: OBOLON: the calm, kind master of a secret society; short questions, long deliberate pauses where the text has 、、、 (silence as a skill), warm and low, never preachy

auditions.name: MONBAN
auditions.brief: MONBAN: the silent gatekeeper; very few words, trailing off with …, low, grave and quiet but not scary, a hidden gentleness

auditions.name: フリージー
auditions.brief: Freezy: a talking refrigerator who loves music; sounds like a cheerful middle-aged guy, an energetic, slightly gruff 'ossan' uncle with a warm husky voice, lively and full of fun, telling dry cold jokes with a laugh in his voice

auditions.name: ヒポキン
auditions.brief: Hipokin: a hippo king who acts like a film director; a very deep, smooth, dandy baritone, slow and confident, effortlessly cool and charming, short punchy instructions, snaps his fingers

auditions.name: たこ焼きブラザー
auditions.brief: Takoyaki Brother: a big, scary-looking but very kind takoyaki man; loud, energetic, says ZE!! at the end of lines, warm underneath

auditions.name: たこ焼きシスター
auditions.brief: Takoyaki Sister: a cool-headed young woman who decides for herself; calm, clear, short sharp remarks, ends lines with わ

auditions.name: 大根カイザー
auditions.brief: Daikon Kaiser: a giant radish emperor who sounds like a kaiju monster; enormous, booming, thick and very low, rumbling, grand and pompous, deeply moved by his own words, ends lines with DA

auditions.name: うんちピンポンくん
auditions.brief: Unchi Pinpon-kun: KIMORIN's tiny silly companion creature; squeaky, cheerful, a little clumsy, very cute

auditions.name: ボスG
auditions.brief: Boss G: the leader of three gorillas on Venus who guide music and style; deep, relaxed, wise, cool like a veteran DJ

auditions.name: ハットG
auditions.brief: Hat G: a stylish gorilla in a hat; friendly, easy-going, encouraging, a smile in the voice

auditions.name: ロングG
auditions.brief: Long G: a tall dreamy gorilla; soft, breezy, poetic, unhurried
